metadata.article_title: Power of Central Government to make rules.

article.title: Power of Central Government to make rules.
article.content:
210CPower of Central Government to make rules.

Section 210C  ·  Chapter XIII  ·  page 115 of the Act
The Central Government may make rules for—
(a) design, construction and maintenance standards for National highways;
(b) such other factors as may be taken into account by the Court under sub-section (3) of section 198A;
4[(ba) the manner in which warning for contraventions shall be recorded under this Chapter;]
(c) any other matter which is, or has to be, prescribed by the Central Government.
4 Ins. by Act 8 of 2026, s. 2 and Sch. (w.e.f. 15-8-2026).
